name: Anjouan (Comoros, 1997–2012)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a white open right hand set within a white crescent.
history: The standard of the last sultan of Anjouan, Omar (c. 1850–1893), was revived by the separatists who hoisted it around 10 May 1997 and declared the island's independence on 3 August 1997. Anjouan kept the flag as an autonomous island under the 2001 federal constitution until the current crescent-and-stars flag replaced it in 2012.

features.symbolism: the name Nzwani, read as 'hand' in local tradition
